item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie told the potential kidnappers of her mother Nancy Guthrie on Saturday that the family is prepared to pay for her safe return.

item.title: H.S. GIRLS BASKETBALL: What we learned in Saturday’s Schuylkill League quarterfinals
item.description: The Schuylkill League playoffs at Martz Hall got underway on Saturday afternoon, and the first round of games lived up to the hype on the girls’ side as North Schuylkill battled Marian Catholic and Mahanoy Area took on Tamaqua. Ultimately, North Schuylkill defeated Marian 49-31, while Mahanoy Area toppled Tamaqua in a thriller, 44-40. item.title: SUPER BOWL: Former Meyers, NFL star Qadry Ismail breaks down the game
item.description: Former Wilkes-Barre Meyers High School star Qadry Ismail is the only player from the Wyoming Valley to win a Super Bowl. He won his ring with the Baltimore Ravens in Super Bowl XXXV when they defeated the New York Giants, 34-7, in Tampa. Ismail also played for the Minnesota Vikings, Miami Dolphins, New Orleans Saints and Indianapolis Colts. He works as a Baltimore Ravens gameday analyst for WJZ in Baltimore. item.title: SUPER BOWL LX: SIBLINGS’ SUPER RIVALRY
item.description: The late Betty Yurcho would have been celebrating her 90th birthday on Super Bowl Sunday, but probably without at least two of her five children present. Her third-born, Judy, would be rooting for her favorite team, the Seattle Seahawks, from the comfort and solitude of her home in the village of Pardeesville in Hazle Twp.
